==INTRO==

Quick, short, fast, action. 3rd person combat. Swarms of aliens.

==GAMEPLAY==

You progress through a set of levels shooting the hell out of everything that movies. You can utilize gadgets to your advantages, like turrets and shields. Multiple difficulties if you enjoy a challenge.

==MULTIPLAYER==

Basically only allows multiplayer, which is really fun. Community is all right, and you can play with up to 3 other friends.

==LENGTH==

Too short, but highly replayable, and other mods for the game can increase it's length with more levels.

==DLC==

None.

==MODS==

One BIG mod that adds TONS of content and maps. Well worth playing if you like the base game.

==PROS AND CONS==

Pros: Free, quick, fun action. Great multiplayer, and nice graphics.

Cons: You're screwed if you don't have at least a team of 3.

==RECOMMENDATIONS==

Who I would recommend this game to: Shooter fans, people with low budgets.

Who I wouldn't recommend this game to: People who want a more tactical experience.

==FINAL SCORE==
9/10: The hidden gem of Valve

One of the best Free to play games, This game is great. Has good quality graphic, sound and movements. Also a lot features, this games is excellent and for the price of free even better. I enjoyed this game a lot in Co-Op with my friends. playable in 4. This game is hard so don't spec to finish it in the first try. But my experience with my friends was awesome we argued, fight and laugh alot while playing this game. This game is easy to understand, configure and also to create matchs or join your friends. So have some fun and play it. I highly recommend it.
